issues.detail: Hebrew 'וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י חַחִ֜י בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ' means 'I will put my hook in your nose' (חַח = hook/ring, אַף = nose). Chinese renders '臂環' (arm ring) and '氣' (breath/anger), which misidentifies both the object (hook vs. arm ring) and the body part (nose vs. breath/anger), changing the meaning.
